milestones.detail: The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. Also, the Department finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive and therefore grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Paul J. Hibbard, Chairman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating and Tim Woolf. (DPU 08-GC-20)
